legacy_name: Step 3: Apply the Target's Immunities, Weaknesses, and Resistances
markdown:
<title level="1" right="Rules">[Step 3: Apply Immunities, Weaknesses, and Resistances](/Rules.aspx?ID=2309)</title>

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 407

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">
Defenses against certain types of damage or effects are called immunities or resistances, while vulnerabilities are called weaknesses. Apply immunities first, then weaknesses, and resistances third. See page 408.
</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>
